blurb: Guests participate in virtual reality experiences including free-roaming VR arena, wired VR escape rooms, competitive VR games, and multisport simulators. The venue also offers esports gaming, party packages, and private event rentals. Food and drinks are available at an in-house snack bar, and the venue can host large groups and private events.
extraNote: All VR and party package sales are final, no refunds · Missed bookings can be rescheduled within 60 days with notice · No adhesive materials or glitter/confetti allowed for parties · Guests must use equipment as instructed; damages may be charged · Alcohol allowed: wine and beer only, must be attended by adult 21+ · Outside food not permitted except desserts with a $25 service fee
